title: Metrics Orchestra: consolidate Prometheus + OTLP into per-request KPI bridge
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a lightweight, tenant-aware telemetry bridge ("Metrics Orchestra") that unifies Prometheus scrape/remote_write metrics and OTLP metric/spans into a single per-request KPI envelope for LLM inference. The bridge will: 1) correlate per-request traces with metrics and exemplars; 2) normalize label contracts (model, route, tenant, variant); 3) perform cardinality-reduction and deterministic sampling; 4) emit standardized histograms and count/ratio KPIs (e.g., request_latency_ms, token_count, kv_cache_hit_rate, generation_error_count) downstream to both Prometheus-compatible storage and the internal timeseries/analytics pipeline. This ticket covers design, PoC sidecar, integration tests, dashboards and an initial canary rollout for a single internal tenant.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar PoC deployed to staging and ingests both OTLP and Prometheus remote_write payloads
Per-request KPI envelope includes trace_id, request_id, model_name, model_variant, tenant_id, route, token_count, request_latency_ms and kv_cache_hit boolean
End-to-end trace->metric linking: exemplars contain trace_id and map to Prometheus histogram buckets for latency
Telemetry overhead measured: sidecar adds < 2ms p50 latency and < 5% p99 overhead under benchmarked traffic
No more than 1% of telemetry events dropped during normal traffic; DLQ captures failures for replay
Dashboards for latency (p50/p95/p99), error rates, token cost per route and cache hit rates are created in Grafana and linked
Automated unit and e2e tests for schema validation, label normalization and cardinality throttling exist and pass in CI
Canary rollout tested with feature flag metrics-orchestra-enabled for one internal tenant and verified over 48h
tasks: RFC: telemetry envelope schema (proto) and label contract — include model/variant/route/tenant
Design doc: sidecar vs gateway tradeoffs, performance targets and backpressure strategy
Prototype: implement sidecar that accepts OTLP/grpc, OTLP/http/json, and Prometheus remote_write
Implement deterministic cardinality reduction (stable hashing + allowlist) and adaptive sampler
Add trace hook: attach trace_id exemplar to histogram buckets and to KPI envelope
DLQ: write failed telemetry to S3 with backoff/retry worker for replay
Integration tests: simulate high-cardinality tenant, assert rate limits and exemplar correctness
Grafana dashboards: latency-by-route, token-cost-per-route, tail-latency-correlations with trace links
Runbook for common failures and SLO alert thresholds
Create GH PR and get design review from Observability and Runtime teams
comments: 2025-01-16 - Aisha Khan: Initial discovery notes. Observed discrepancy between Prom metrics and OTLP histograms for per-request latency. Hypothesis: different labeling and missing exemplars. Drafted schema for unified envelope.

2025-01-22 - Marco Silva: Design review with Runtime and Observability. Main trade-offs: sidecar per node (low latency, easier trace linking) vs centralized gateway (simpler ops). We agreed on sidecar for first phase with an eventual central multiplexer.
2025-01-28 - PM (Elena Park): Prioritized for Dedicated customers with high cardinality use cases. Suggested tenant-shaping knobs and opt-in by customer because of label privacy concerns.

2025-02-01 - Marco Silva: Perf PoC results attached. Under simulated traffic (10k req/s), sidecar median overhead ~1.6ms, p99 ~8.2ms. Need to optimize histogram serialization and batch remote_write to reduce p99. Open PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/212
2025-02-03 - Security (Rohit Mehta): Reviewed label contract. Recommend redacting PII in route labels and defaulting tenant_id to hashed pseudonymization. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-02-04 - Aisha Khan: Feature flags in place: metrics-orchestra-enabled, metrics-orchestra-sampling-rate. Preparing canary for 2025-02-10 for tenant: internal-observability-team. Linked dashboard: grafana/redwood/obs-metrics-orchestra-canary
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (staging): deploy sidecar to staging cluster, run synthetic loads and verify exemplar linking
Phase 1 (internal canary): enable for internal-observability-team tenant for 48h, monitor p99 overhead and metric completeness
Phase 2 (limited external): enable for three low-traffic customers behind feature flag, monitor cardinality and storage costs
Phase 3 (GA): document migration path for Prom metrics producers and enable default for new Dedicated clusters
production_verification: Run the telemetry completeness job and assert parity with existing Prom scrape counts (>=99% matching for core KPIs)
Verify exemplars are resolvable in Jaeger/Tempo using trace_id from Grafana histogram hover
Validate that cardinality reduction keeps label count under tenant quota (as configured)
Confirm DLQ replay pipeline can restore missing envelopes into analytics storage without duplicates
